content.content:
usage: run_checks.py [-h] [--changed-from REF] [--kinds KINDS] [--all]
                     [--battery BATTERY] [--level LEVEL] [--list] [--explain]
                     [--github] [--selftest] [--print-plan] [--dry-run]
                     [--base REF] [--registry REGISTRY]

scripts/run_checks.py — the single entry point for every ecosystem check.

Reads governance/check-registry.yaml, works out which checks the current change
actually warrants, runs them, and reports. CI and scripts/preflight.sh both call
this, so there is one list of checks in the repo rather than four hand-kept ones
that drift apart.

WHAT "GATING" MEANS HERE
------------------------
Each check declares the WORK KINDS it is relevant to (data / schema / synthesis /
governance / render / tooling, or `always`). This script classifies a diff into
kinds and runs the intersection. A docs-only change runs the always-on checks; a
data change runs the DB, schema and freshness batteries; a synthesis change runs
the judgment and attestation batteries.

Checks:
  C1  registry parses and every check id is unique
  C2  every referenced battery is declared
  C3  every check's executable exists on disk (catches a rename that skipped its
      caller sweep — architecture v2.3 <migration_and_growth>)
  C4  path classification maps representative paths to the expected kinds
  C5  selection honours kinds, batteries and `always`
  (C1-C5 are the --selftest. A gate nobody has watched fire is not a gate.)

Usage:
    python3 scripts/run_checks.py --changed-from origin/main   # gate a branch
    python3 scripts/run_checks.py --all                        # everything
    python3 scripts/run_checks.py --kinds data,schema          # explicit kinds
    python3 scripts/run_checks.py --battery schema --kinds data
    python3 scripts/run_checks.py --list                       # registry table
    python3 scripts/run_checks.py --explain --changed-from HEAD~1
    python3 scripts/run_checks.py --selftest

THE BASE. A registered cmd may name `@BASE@`; it becomes the ref given to --changed-from (or to
--base, which sets it alone for --all and --kinds runs), else origin/main. That is how a
changeset-scoped check (research_tooling_separation, the attestation checks) diffs the base the
gate was given rather than a literal in the registry.

The summary names, apart from the verdict, what a green run does not show: SKIPPED (did not run),
NOTHING-IN-SCOPE (ran, examined nothing) and NO-EXAMINED (ran, printed no count the runner can read).

Exit codes:
    0  no blocking check failed
    1  at least one blocking check failed
    2  the runner itself could not run (bad registry, bad arguments, an unknown --battery or --level,

A resolution by an Opus-class model under the owner's twelfth instruction of 2026-11-12 ("You have permission to use Opus for judgment if appropriate here") and the line its [ASSUMPTION] draws, applied at the owner's question of 2026-11-13, with the conditions (a) to (e) of the delegation of 2026-11-12 applied to it; judged against the owner's three criteria in the order ratified by OI-14. **It is not the owner's words**, and it stands until the owner reverses it. Checked under condition (d) (`workplan/2026-11-12-bidirectional-pipeline/DELEGATED-RESOLUTIONS-2-REVIEW.md`, OD-45): confirmed with corrections, which are applied here. Reasoning: `workplan/2026-11-12-bidirectional-pipeline/DELEGAT

OD-45: a search not run, deferred

**The resolution.** A logged search whose request returned no result list (a 403 or bot challenge, a 429, a connection reset, a stub page) is a search not run: recorded with `deferred_reason` naming the failure, with no absence class, and owed a re-run, including the Internet Archive route.

**What decided it.** R14 (absence is evidence only for a well-formed query), the operative instrument ("`deferred_reason` is for searches *not run*, never a findings channel"), the principle of the owner's 2026-09-18 ruling on deferred citation mining ('deferred is okay so long as it runs eventually'), applied by analogy. Criterion 1: the book never reports absence where nothing was searched.

**Reversal condition.** The owner wants a blocked request kept as a finding about a source's reachability.

CONDITION: any session logging, classifying or re-running a search.
ACTION: (1) Log a request with no result list as deferred, with its reason. (2) Give it no absence class. (3) Re-run it. (4) Read a zero-result search as a finding only where `deferred_reason` is NULL. (5) Read this decision through the gate; its independent check is recorded below.
DATE: 2026-11-13 — delegated resolution under the twelfth instruction, not an owner statement.

OD-45 STATUS: RESOLVED UNDER DELEGATION
(81, 'hathitrust', 0, 'ZERO-YIELD, AND THE INSTRUMENT IS BAD RATHER THAN THE INDEX EMPTY — this is an R14 query-shape failure of a kind R14 does not name. Both requests returned HTTP 200 carrying a Cloudflare interstitial: "Just a moment... Enable JavaScript and cookies to continue" (5696 and 5753 bytes, persisted). ## Defects, worst first

**D1 MEDIUM — T-081 §2's precondition check expects the wrong number.**
- It says `amend-search --help | grep -c set-deferred-reason` "prints 1".
- `for c in 60 80 250; do COLUMNS=$c python3 scripts/db.py amend-search --help | grep -c set-deferred-reason; done` prints `2 2 2`: the flag appears on both the usage line and the option line.
- §9 says to stop when a precondition is unmet, so a correct executor will stop after the flag has merged.
- This check is the only guard on the dependency. The plan generator (`build_batches.py` l.77-88) reads only `T-\d+` ids from that bullet, so REMEDIATION-PLAN.md does not show the dependency at all.
- It also breaks rule 7a: a typed result instead of the command.

**D2 MEDIUM — T-081 §9's stop condition can no longer fire for a deferral.**
- The new clause allows refusals for "(for a deferral) the states its refusal names". Every deferral refusal names a state, so every possible refusal is excused.
- §3 fixes the four rows as zero-result, unclassed, undeferred and unadmitted. Any refusal on them therefore means the ground has moved, which is exactly what §9 exists to catch.

**D3 MEDIUM — the new refusal attributes DR-2026-08-19's words to R6, and the "deliberately" prose is left stale.**
